asks: Can you see the mountains at the bottom?
description: A pale moon about the size of a head, hanging up near the ceiling, cratered and quite cold-looking, giving out a soft even light that reaches the corners better than a bulb ever has.
emotes: {it} turns another degree and a new crater comes into the light.
{it} dims to a crescent and slowly fills again.
{it} drifts a hand span and settles.
looks: It's turning, slowly, and the far side comes round about once a minute.
The craters are picked out in shadow and there are mountains at the bottom edge.
It gives no heat whatsoever, and the light is the colour of a night you remember.
name: a small moon near the ceiling
says: I'm much further away than I look.
I do this whether or not anybody is in.
Nothing up here has changed in a while.
